doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Amendment to the Social Security Contribution Levy Act, No. 25 of 2022
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - A Bill has been prepared by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Social Security Contribution Levy Act, No.25 of 2022 as per a budget proposal 2026. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
